# commit-sha-pin: pinned revisions. a commit sha identifies a revision, it is not a secret.
# the hex here is generated by the test, so the repository holds no opaque literal.
# known gap: a digest pinned inside a larger reference is reported, because the value spans the
# reference and not the digest: `image: registry.example.internal/acme/widget@sha256:<64 hex>`,
# `FROM node:22-alpine@sha256:<64 hex>`, `"resolved": "git+https://host/repo.git#<40 hex>"` and
# `uses: docker://ghcr.example.internal/acme/widget@<40 hex>`. add them here once the layer covers them.
      uses: actions/checkout@{HEX40} # v7.0.0
      uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@{HEX40} # 1.17.0
rev = "{HEX40}"
    revision = "{HEX40}"
    "revision": "{HEX40}"
    ref: {HEX40}
git checkout {HEX40}
source_commit: {HEX40}
commit: {HEX40}
